features: Shelf and overflow management with edit/save
Persistent user data across every install and update
new_in_2_0_3: User data now lives in a persistent OS-managed location (~/Library/Application Support/HarvestHero on macOS, %APPDATA%\HarvestHero on Windows) so passwords and inventory survive every ZIP extract and re-install.
Automatic one-time migration copies any legacy DB from the old in-code-folder location into the persistent one on first launch.
Release ZIP no longer contains the developer's inventory database, secret key, .env files, or dev-tool folders.
New build_source_zip.sh / .bat builds a clean, git-archive-based release ZIP that cannot leak untracked files.
Auto-updater no longer needs to guess which folders to preserve — user data is physically outside the code folder now.
recent_fixes: Users no longer need to reset their password after every update.
Client inventory data is preserved through manual ZIP re-extract, not just auto-updates.
Empty shelves persist and display in Manage Shelves, Inventory, and Pantry views.
Storage location changes sync across all views automatically.

deployment.update_frequency: Check on startup and daily at 2 AM
deployment.data_preservation: User data lives outside the code folder; re-extracting or replacing the app never touches it.
